timetable.method: west zone: text layer of the official PDF (legacy Bangla font decoded by tools/train/br/bijoy_fix.py, table grid by gridlib.py); east zone: hand transcription of the scanned official PDF; per-stop times are the official 'abbreviated schedule' (major stops) for intercity trains, mail/commuter/local trains have official origin + destination times only
timetable.not_included: freight/container trains (601-608), the 19 west-zone departmental/PNV services, unnumbered suspended DEMU commuters (Nazirhat, Chittagong University, Kaliakair, Narayanganj DEMU) — listed in owner_actions/TRAIN_TRACKER_V2_BN.md
timetable.cross_check: station-page times that differ from the abbreviated schedule (kept: schedule)
